thread:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to schedule a 60m security/privacy/compliance triage to cover: threat-model updates, SOC2 pre-check items, and the contractor access review. Week of Mar 23 works for me. Who can attend? @Arjun @Jules @Sam @Priya :calendar:
Jules: I can do Wed or Thu. Prefer Wed 10–11am PT.

Arjun: Wed 10 also ok for me. If it helps, I can present the latest threat model deltas (5–7m).

Sam: Thu 3–4pm PT is better on my end (deploys Wed morning). If Wed it has to be afternoon.

Priya: Legal side: need the SOC2 pre-check doc and the access roster 48h before. Can join either slot but prefer Thu. Please add details about data classifications we should flag.

Maya: Good notes. Proposed agenda (rough):
1) 5m — goals / scope (Maya)
2) 10m — threat-model deltas (Arjun)
3) 15m — SOC2 pre-check / high-risk controls (Priya + Jules)
4) 15m — access review: contractors, service accounts, SSO config (Sam + Infra)
5) 10m — action items & owners / follow-ups

Maya: Pre-reads (please skim before meeting):
- Threat model (latest): https://redwood.cloud/docs/threat-models/product-x#v2
- SOC2 pre-check checklist: https://redwood.cloud/internal/compliance/soc2-precheck.md
- Access matrix (contractors): https://redwood.cloud/internal/iam/access-matrix-contractors.csv

Maya: Also, run this SSO log query if you want to surface recent contractor activity quickly:
```sql
SELECT user_email, action, resource, timestamp
FROM sso_audit_logs
WHERE user_email LIKE '%@contractor.com'
  AND timestamp > now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY timestamp desc
LIMIT 200;
```

infra-bot: Note — SSO logs available in the infra-logs bucket (s3://redwood-logs/sso/). Use `aws s3 cp` to pull.

calendar-bot: Poll created — please vote for your preferred slot: https://polls.redwood.company/p/4a9f

Jules: Voted — I picked Wed 10. I can own the SOC2 controls walkthrough for item 3.

Arjun: Wed 10 confirmed from me. I'll attach the threat model diff to the calendar invite.

Sam: Voted Thu 3, but can move to Wed if 4 ppl confirmed. If Wed happens, I'll join remotely and mute during deploy windows.

Priya: Voted Thu 3. For the access review, can someone prepare a short CSV with: principal, role, last_login, mfa_enabled? That would speed things up.

Maya: @Sam / @Infra — can you generate that CSV and drop it in the folder by EOD Tue? Filename: access_review_contractors_<date>.csv. Also @Jules please attach the SOC2 pre-check export.

Sam: Yup I can generate the CSV. Will include last_login and mfa flag.

Jules: I'll export the controls status and attach.

Maya: Okay leaning toward Thu 3 since Legal prefers Thu and Sam voted Thu. If calendar poll stays Thu, I'll finalize and send invite with agenda + pre-reads. Record meeting and add notes to /notes/security/triage/<date>.md :memo:

Priya: Thu works for me. Please add bullet for any upcoming audits (external) so we can prioritize controls.

Maya: Will do. Final action items before meeting:
- Arjun: threat-model diff + 2-slide summary (attach by Wed EOD)
- Sam: contractor access CSV (by Tue EOD)
- Jules: SOC2 pre-check export (by Tue EOD)
- Priya: list of legal/controls questions to flag (optional pre-read)
- Infra: confirm SSO logs path + retention (infra-bot already noted)

Maya: Thanks all — I'll finalize once poll results are in. If anyone can't make it, flag here and we'll row back to an async status update instead. :pray:

calendar-bot: Poll results: Thu 2026-03-26 15:00 PT (4 votes), Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT (2 votes). Invite will be sent for Thu 2026-03-26 15:00 PT. 

Maya: Invite sent. See you Thu 3pm PT.
